Container.Name: rangebook
Container.Overview: Range Book: a self-hosted ballistics calculator and reloading log with a sign-in for each person. Trajectory tables, dope cards and field mode; reloading recipes with ladder tests, chronograph imports (LabRadar, Garmin, MagnetoSpeed, RangeCraft) and target photos you can measure; gun, ammo and component inventory with cost per round; range trips and a range log. Works as a home-screen app on a phone, including with no signal when reached over https. After the first start, open the WebUI and create your admin account right away.
Container.Description: Self-hosted ballistics calculator and reloading log. Open the WebUI after the first start and create your admin account right away.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the web page. Change the host side if 9090 is taken.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Suggested username for the admin account you create on the first-run Welcome page.

Config.Name: HTTPS cookie (COOKIE_SECURE)
Config.Description: Set true when you reach Range Book through https (reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel).

Config.Name: Behind a proxy (TRUST_PROXY)
Config.Description: Set true behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel so sign-in limits see real addresses.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, used for dates and the nightly backup time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data folder (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data folder (100 = users).

Config.Name: Sample load (IMPORT_SEED)
Config.Description: The first account gets a made-up sample 6.5 Creedmoor ladder. Set false to start empty.

Config.Name: Backup hour
Config.Description: Hour of the night (0-23) for the automatic backup.

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: How many daily backups to keep.
